de: French explorer Jacques Cartier sets sail on his second voyage to North America with three ships, 110 men, and Chief Donnacona's two sons (whom Cartier had kidnapped during his first voyage).

t: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳被代理嫁给了威尔士亲王亚瑟. 凯瑟琳是13,亚瑟是12.
te: Catherine of Aragon is married by proxy to Arthur, Prince of Wales. Catherine is 13 and Arthur is 12.
dz: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳被代理嫁给了威尔士亲王亚瑟. 凯瑟琳是13,亚瑟是12.
de: Catherine of Aragon is married by proxy to Arthur, Prince of Wales. Catherine is 13 and Arthur is 12.

t: 卡斯蒂利亚的约翰二世在第一次奥尔梅多战役中击败了阿拉贡的"婴儿".
te: John II of Castile defeats the Infantes of Aragon at the First Battle of Olmedo.
dz: 卡斯蒂利亚的约翰二世在第一次奥尔梅多战役中击败了阿拉贡的"婴儿".
de: John II of Castile defeats the Infantes of Aragon at the First Battle of Olmedo.

t: 法国的亨利一世与罗斯的公主基辅的安妮结婚.
te: Henry I of France marries the Rus' princess, Anne of Kiev.
dz: 法国的亨利一世与罗斯的公主基辅的安妮结婚.
de: Henry I of France marries the Rus' princess, Anne of Kiev.

t: 拜占庭帝国在约翰·库库阿斯的领导下重新征服了梅利泰内。
te: The Byzantine Empire reconquers Melitene under the leadership of John Kourkouas.
dz: 拜占庭帝国在约翰·库库阿斯的领导下重新征服了梅利泰内。
de: The Byzantine Empire reconquers Melitene under the leadership of John Kourkouas.

t: 教皇格列高利二世当选。
te: Pope Gregory II is elected.
dz: 教皇格列高利二世当选。
de: Pope Gregory II is elected.

t: Ashina Jiesheshuai和他的部落人袭击了吉正宫的太宗皇帝.
te: Ashina Jiesheshuai and his tribesmen assault Emperor Taizong at Jiucheng Palace.
dz: Ashina Jiesheshuai和他的部落人袭击了吉正宫的太宗皇帝.
de: Ashina Jiesheshuai and his tribesmen assault Emperor Taizong at Jiucheng Palace.
